column1: # The lab's demo pull requests, one per line, tab separated: branch, fixture, class, verdict, title, what Proven should say.
# fixture is a directory of testdata/fixture: the lab commits its base tree to main, and its change tree on the branch.
# The workflow reads the fixture from the branch name (demo-<fixture>) and runs `proven scan --sample` on it, so the
# review a pull request gets is the review the sample set records for that fixture. Nothing here is invented.
# class is what the pull request demonstrates. Two defect pull requests may not share a class; a test holds that.
# verdict is clean (Proven should report nothing) or defect (Proven should report with evidence).
